about_the_game: Help Scorchie, a friendly and hyperactive will-o'-wisp, to save his friends against a mysterious and perverse sludge while venturing out into a vast and diverse world in this tight platformer game! Brave dozens of challenges, uncover secrets, and piece together the mystery of the purple sludge using Scorchie's dash abilities!
